title: jensen-plugin-api
description: The wire contract between Jensen and a plugin, apiVersion 1. It is the single source of truth: Jensen's broker and the @jensen-org/plugin-sdk are both generated from it. Every message is {v:1, id, kind, ...} sent over a MessagePort handed to the plugin realm at boot. There is deliberately no method that adds a page or a route: Jensen has exactly three pages and panes are the only open ended surface.

handler.description: A plugin side callback id. Jensen answers with node.event when it fires.

offset.description: UTF-16 code unit offset into the document.

column.description: Zero based column in UTF-16 code units.

key.description: A chord such as Mod+Shift+D. Mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

when.description: A context key expression, for example editorFocus or paneFocus:plugin:dev.me.hello/view.

label.description: The tooltip and the accessible name.

path.description: Null for an unsaved scratch buffer.

pluginId.description: Present when the pane belongs to a plugin.

paneId.description: The id the owning plugin registered it under.

plugin.hello.summary: The first call a plugin makes. Jensen answers with who it is running as.

plugin.ready.summary: Sent once onload has finished, so Jensen can release activation events.

log.summary: Writes to Jensen's app log under the plugin's name.

storage.load.summary: Reads the plugin's own persisted data. Null before the first save.

storage.save.summary: Replaces the plugin's own persisted data.

workspace.currentPage.summary: Which of the three fixed pages is showing. There is no way to add or change pages.

workspace.registerPane.summary: Registers a pane kind. It appears in the pane picker under Plugins and can be opened any number of times unless singleton.

render.description: declarative: the plugin returns a node tree Jensen draws with its own components. custom: the plugin's bundle runs again inside a sandboxed frame and draws itself.

workspace.setPaneState.summary: Stores state with the pane so it survives a reload, then re-renders it.

workspace.refreshPane.summary: Asks Jensen to call pane.render again. Without an instance it refreshes every pane the plugin owns.

commands.register.summary: Adds a command to the palette and, with a hotkey, to the keymap. Users can rebind it in Settings.

checked.description: True when the plugin answers command.check to decide availability.

commands.execute.summary: Runs any command, including Jensen's own. Plugin command ids are plugin:<pluginId>/<id>.

keymap.get.summary: The chords currently bound to a command, after the user's own overrides.

settings.registerTab.summary: Adds a section to Settings under Extensions. Jensen asks for its controls with settings.render and draws them with its own components.

settings.get.summary: Reads one of Jensen's own settings.

theme.register.summary: Adds a theme document, validated against schema/theme.schema.json.

editor.replaceRange.summary: Edits the active buffer as one undoable transaction labelled with the plugin id.

editor.insert.summary: Inserts at an offset, or at the cursor when none is given.

editor.setDecorations.summary: Replaces the plugin's decorations under a key. They are visual only and cannot change the buffer, so reading is enough.

fs.watch.summary: Starts delivering fs.changed events for a granted directory.

ui.suggest.summary: A searchable list. Resolves to the picked item id, or null when dismissed.

ui.registerMenu.summary: Contributes items to a context menu. Jensen asks for them with menu.build each time the menu opens.

ui.setStatus.summary: Creates or updates an item in the status strip.

markdown.registerRenderer.summary: Renders fenced code blocks of one language. Jensen asks for html with markdown.render and sanitizes what comes back.

command.run.summary: A command the plugin registered was invoked.

command.check.summary: Whether the command is available right now, so the palette can hide it.

pane.render.summary: Asks a declarative pane for its node tree.

node.event.summary: A control inside a rendered node tree fired its handler.

context.description: What the menu opened on: path for explorer, tab or editor, paneKind for pane.

plugin.unload.summary: Jensen is disabling or reloading the plugin. Dispose everything and resolve.
